rationale: The workflow already caches Nix dependencies and build outputs via Cachix (cachix/cachix-action@v17), which is the dependency-cache optimization addressed by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE; that pattern's contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" applies, so adding a separate package-manager cache would be unrelated and redundant. No matrix jobs exist, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST and P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST do not apply. There are no scheduled triggers, so P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE do not apply. The job is single, so job reordering is not applicable. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history to set a safe limit, but the provided CI history contains only conclusions, not durations, and imposing an arbitrary timeout on a Nix build risks interrupting valid slow runs and reducing coverage. No pip/npm installation step exists for a package-manager dependency cache. No supported, safe optimization fits while preserving intended build and test coverage.
